arxiv-2103-07632.title: Nonlinear dynamics of topological Dirac fermions in 2D spin-orbit coupled materials
arxiv-2103-07632.creator: Rajesh K. Malla, Wilton J. M. Kort-Kamp ∗
arxiv-2103-07632.description: Abstract The graphene family materials are two-dimensional staggered monolayers with a gapped energy band structure due to intrinsic spin-orbit coupling. The mass gaps in these materials can be manipulated on-demand via biasing with a static electric field, an off-resonance circularly polarized laser, or an exchange interaction field, allowing the monolayer to be driven through a multitude of topological phase transitions.

arxiv-2106-11850.title: When quantum state tomography benefits from willful ignorance Journal: New Journal of Physics
arxiv-2106-11850.creator: Libor Motka, Martin Paúr, Jaroslav Řeháček, Zdeněk Hradil, Luis L Sánchez-Soto
arxiv-2106-11850.description: Abstract We show that quantum state tomography with perfect knowledge of the measurement apparatus proves to be, in some instances, inferior to strategies discarding all information about the measurement at hand, as in the case of data pattern tomography. In those scenarios, the larger uncertainty about the measurement is traded for the smaller uncertainty about the reconstructed signal.

arxiv-2212-12473.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jason P. Bell. We disprove a 2002 conjecture of Dombi from additive number theory. arxiv-2304-04027.title: NeBLa: Neural Beer-Lambert for 3D Reconstruction of Oral Structures from Panoramic Radiographs
arxiv-2304-04027.creator: Sihwa Park, Seongjun Kim, Doeyoung Kwon, Yohan Jang, In-Seok Song, Seung Jun Baek
arxiv-2304-04027.description: Abstract Panoramic radiography (Panoramic X-ray, PX) is a widely used imaging modality for dental examination. However, PX only provides a flattened 2D image, lacking in a 3D view of the oral structure. In this paper, we propose NeBLa (Neural Beer-Lambert) to estimate 3D oral structures from real-world PX.

arxiv-2305-18423.title: On the Role of Noise in the Sample Complexity of Learning Recurrent Neural Networks: Exponential Gaps for Long Sequences
arxiv-2305-18423.creator: Alireza Fathollah Pour, Hassan Ashtiani
arxiv-2305-18423.description: Abstract We consider the class of noisy multi-layered sigmoid recurrent neural networks with w w (unbounded) weights for classification of sequences of length T T , where independent noise distributed according to 𝒩 ⁡ ( 0 , σ 2 ) \mathcal{N}(0,\sigma^{2}) is added to the output of each neuron in the network.

arxiv-2310-14322.title: Boundary homogenization for target search problems
arxiv-2310-14322.creator: Denis S. Grebenkov and Alexei T. Skvortsov
arxiv-2310-14322.description: Abstract In this review, we describe several approximations in the theory of Laplacian transport near complex or heterogeneously reactive boundaries. This phenomenon, governed by the Laplace operator, is ubiquitous in fields as diverse as chemical physics, hydrodynamics, electrochemistry, heat transfer, wave propagation, self-organization, biophysics, and target search.

arxiv-2403-07783.title: QCD Equation of State at nonzero baryon density in external magnetic field
arxiv-2403-07783.creator: N. Astrakhantsev, V. V. Braguta, A. Yu. Kotov, A. A. Roenko
arxiv-2403-07783.description: Abstract This paper is devoted to the study of QCD equation of state in external magnetic field and nonzero baryon density. Our study is carried out by means of lattice simulation with 2+1 dynamical staggered quarks at the physical masses. The simulation is conducted at imaginary baryon chemical potential what allowed us to overcome the sign problem.

arxiv-2405-11988.title: DuckDB-SGX2: The Good, The Bad and The Ugly within Confidential Analytical Query Processing Conference: 20th International Workshop on Data Management on New Hardware ; June 10, 2024; Santiago, AA, Chile 20th International Workshop on Data Management on New Hardware (DaMoN ’24), June 10, 2024, Santi
arxiv-2405-11988.creator: Ilaria Battiston, Lotte Felius, Sam Ansmink, Laurens Kuiper, Peter Boncz
arxiv-2405-11988.description: Abstract . We provide an evaluation of an analytical workload in a confidential computing environment, combining DuckDB with two technologies: modular columnar encryption in Parquet files (data at rest) and the newest version of the Intel SGX Trusted Execution Environment (TEE), providing a hardware enclave where data in flight can be (more) securely decrypted and processed.

arxiv-2407-17935.title: Pfaffian structure of the eigenvector overlap for the symplectic Ginibre ensemble
arxiv-2407-17935.creator: Gernot Akemann, Sung-Soo Byun, Kohei Noda
arxiv-2407-17935.description: Abstract . We study the integrable structure and scaling limits of the conditioned eigenvector overlap of the symplectic Ginibre ensemble of Gaussian non-Hermitian random matrices with independent quaternion elements. The average of the overlap matrix elements constructed from left and right eigenvectors, conditioned to x x , are derived in terms of a Pfaffian determinant.

arxiv-2501-01364.title: Two characterizations of Sheffer-Dunkl sequences
arxiv-2501-01364.creator: Alejandro Gil Asensi, Judit Mínguez Ceniceros
arxiv-2501-01364.description: Abstract Sheffer polynomials can be characterized using different Stieltjes integrals. These families of polynomials have been recently extended to the Dunkl context. In this way some classical operators as the derivative operator or the difference operator are replaced as analogous operators in the Dunkl universe.

arxiv-2508-15096.title: Nemotron-cc-math: A 133 Billion-Token-Scale High Quality Math Pretraining Dataset
arxiv-2508-15096.creator: Rabeeh Karimi Mahabadi, Sanjeev Satheesh, Shrimai Prabhumoye, Mostofa Patwary, Mohammad Shoeybi, Bryan Catanzaro
arxiv-2508-15096.description: Abstract Pretraining large language models (LLMs) on high-quality, structured data such as mathematics and code substantially enhances reasoning capabilities. However, existing math-focused datasets built from Common Crawl suffer from degraded quality due to brittle extraction heuristics, lossy HTML-to-text conversion, and the failure to reliably preserve mathematical structure.

arxiv-2601-07732.title: Semisimple algebraic groups over real closed fields
arxiv-2601-07732.creator: Raphael Appenzeller
arxiv-2601-07732.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Raphael Appenzeller. We give a self-contained introduction to linear algebraic and semialgebraic groups over real closed fields, and we generalize several key results about semisimple Lie groups to algebraic and semialgebraic groups over real closed fields. We prove that a torus in a semisimple algebraic group is maximal ℝ \mathbb{R} -split if and only if it is maximal 𝔽 \mathbb{F} -split for real closed fields 𝔽 \mathbb{F} .

pmc-10571777.creator: Olga I. Zakharova, Fedor I. Korennoy, Ivan V. Yashin, Olga A. Burova, Elena A. Liskova, Nadezhda A. Gladkova, Irina V. Razheva, Andrey A. Blokhin

pmc-10594691.title: Curative effect of external fixation combined with kirschner wire versus hollow screw in the treatment of first metacarpal bone base fracture
pmc-10594691.creator: Jian Liu, Zhengfeng Lu, Gang Zhao, Yuzhou Liu, Haoyu Yang, Mingyu Xue
pmc-10594691.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). PurposeThis study was conducted aimed at comparing the curative effect of external fixation combined with Kirschner wire fixation versus hollow screw fixation in the treatment of first metacarpal bone base fracture.MethodsThe current retrospective study included a total of 80 patients diagnosed with first metacarpal bone base fracture who were admitted in Wuxi 9th People’s Hospital Affiliated to Soochow University between October 2017 and October 2020.

pmc-10631673.title: Telerehabilitation use and experiences in occupational and physical therapy through the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic
pmc-10631673.creator: Golda Nguyen, Katelyn King, Leia Stirling
pmc-10631673.description: Telehealth has helped to increase access to rehabilitative services such as occupational and physical therapy. The early COVID-19 pandemic amplified the need for remote access to care, and the rapid implementation of telehealth systems provided a unique opportunity to learn from clinicians’ experiences adopting telehealth for telerehabilitation applications.

pmc-11466616.title: The One Health approach in urban ecosystem rehabilitation: An evidence-based framework for designing sustainable cities
pmc-11466616.creator: Antonia Bruno, Irene Arnoldi, Benedetta Barzaghi, Marco Boffi, Maurizio Casiraghi, Beatrice Colombo, Patrizia Di Gennaro, Sara Epis, Federica Facciotti, Nicola Ferrari, Elisa Fesce, Gentile Francesco Ficetola, Sara Fumagalli, Andrea Galimberti, Giulia Ghisleni, Werther Guidi Nissim, Luca Mainardi, R
pmc-11466616.description: SummaryRapid urbanization has led to negative, and sometimes unintended, consequences on biodiversity and human health. While cities offer numerous advantages in meeting the basic needs of a growing population, they also pose less apparent and longer-term health costs. To address the multifaceted impacts of urbanization, an evidence-based design framework for establishing mitigation and regeneration actions is essential.

pmc-11590575.title: Genome-aware annotation of CRISPR guides validates targets in variant cell lines and enhances discovery in screens
pmc-11590575.creator: Simon Lam, John C Thomas, Stephen P Jackson
pmc-11590575.description: BackgroundCRISPR-Cas9 technology has revolutionised genetic screens and can inform on gene essentiality and chemo-genetic interactions. It is easily deployed and widely supported with many pooled CRISPR libraries available commercially. However, discrepancies between the reference genomes used in the design of those CRISPR libraries and the cell line under investigation can lead to loss of signal or introduction of bias.

pmc-11637414.title: Gut microbiota diversity repeatedly diminishes over time following maintenance infliximab infusions in paediatric IBD patients
pmc-11637414.creator: Katrine Carlsen, Louise B. Thingholm, Astrid Dempfle, Mikkel Malham, Corinna Bang, Andre Franke, Vibeke Wewer, Jonathan Jacobs, Jonathan Jacobs, Jonathan Jacobs, Jonathan Jacobs
pmc-11637414.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe gut microbiome plays a crucial role in the pathogenesis and progression of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Understanding the dynamics of the gut microbiome in relation to treatment can provide valuable insights into disease management and therapy strategies.

pmc-11716878.title: Do patients with early‐stage cognitive impairment have an increased risk to develop malnutrition? A cross‐sectional study
pmc-11716878.creator: Pedro de Castro Lopes, Amanda Aparecida Oliveira Leopoldino, João Carlos Barbosa Machado, Maira Tonidandel Barbosa, Luana Rodrigues Garcia, Bianca Pessoa Aguiar, Júlia Caroline Barbosa de Souza, João Pedro Neres Antunes Ferreira
pmc-11716878.description: BackgroundMalnutrition is a condition associated with negative outcomes in elderly patients, such as loss of functionality and mortality. The cause of malnutrition is multifactorial: secondary to changes in eating habits, dysphagia and loss of interest in food. It is a frequent condition in patients with advanced dementia.

pmc-12579999.title: Liposarcoma Arising From Mature Teratoma Following Testicular Tumor Surgery: A Case Report
pmc-12579999.creator: Mai Yamazaki, Kousuke Kitamura, Kanako Ogura, Gento Oomae, Kazuhiko Mizushima, Takahiro Nonami, Yuto Miyoshi, Yoshirou Sakamoto, Satoru Muto
pmc-12579999.description: IntroductionTesticular germ cell tumors (GCTs) are rare cancers. Mature teratomas may rarely undergo somatic malignant transformation (SMT) and may exhibit histological features resembling those of sarcomas.CaseA 22‐year‐old male presented to our hospital with a complaint of a left scrotal mass.

pmc-12838036.title: Stratified patterns of healthcare-seeking behavior among older adults in Fujian, China: exploring the behavioral foundations of health inequality
pmc-12838036.creator: Wei Luo, Jiaxin Liu, Hao Yang, Wenji Qiu, Jinghong Huang, Xiaojun Liu
pmc-12838036.description: BackgroundChina is experiencing rapid population aging amid longstanding but gradually narrowing disparities in health resource allocation. As insurance coverage, primary care capacity, and basic service availability become increasingly equitable, variations in healthcare-seeking behaviors have become a key pathway through which socio-economic differences are reproduced as health inequalities.

pmc-12859914.title: First record of Prosogonotrema bilabiatum Vigueras, 1940 (digenea: Sclerodistomidae) in marine fishes from the Persian Gulf, Hormozgan Province, Southern Iran
pmc-12859914.creator: Aida Vafae Eslahi, Majid Pirestani, Zahra Gharibi, Ioannis Adamopoulos, Amin Karampour, Faezeh Mohammadi, Fatemeh Samiee-Rad, Khadijeh Ahmadi, Milad Badri, Luís Madeira de Carvalho
pmc-12859914.description: BackgroundThis study documents the first occurrence of the digenean trematode Prosogonotrema bilabiatum in marine fish from the Persian Gulf, Iran.MethodsOne hundred eighty-two specimens of four ecologically and economically important marine fish species (Alectis indica, Rachycentron canadum, Seriola dumerili, and Solea elongata) were examined between January 2023 and December 2024 in Hormozgan Province using light microscopy and molecular techniques.

pmc-13271634.title: Gut Lactate Boosts Ruminococcus via Histone Lactylation to Mediate Time‐Restricted Feeding Protection in Crohn's Disease
pmc-13271634.creator: Linwen Huang, Huishi Tan, Senhui Weng, Yuntao Liu, Lingxu Song, Shaoyu Cheng, Zelong Lin, Jiawei Chen, Fei Tan, Jun Wang, Jinke Huang, Linkun Cai, Jiwei Chai, Cailing Zhong, Yanqiang Shi, Wendi Zhang, Haiyan Zhang, Chongyang Huang
pmc-13271634.description: Background: Crohn's disease (CD) is characterized by impaired epithelial barrier function and dysregulated gut microbiota, particularly characterized by a reduced abundance of short‐chain fatty acid (SCFA)‐producing bacteria such as Ruminococcus. Time‐restricted feeding (TRF), which limits daily food intake to specific feeding windows, has been demonstrated to restore microbial balance, enrich SCFA‐producing bacteria, and enhance gut homeostasis.

pmc-13534971.title: Homologous recombination mutants cause differing lethality between h− and h+ Schizosaccharomyces pombe strains due to mat1 heterochromatin
pmc-13534971.creator: Peter Kolesar, Siarhei Paliavoi, Barbora Stefanovie, Jan Josef Palecek
pmc-13534971.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Homologous recombination (HR) is generally considered dispensable in yeast and vertebrates, yet mounting evidence indicates that its essentiality depends on cellular context. Here, we dissect the basis of this context dependency in Schizosaccharomyces pombe. In the homothallic h 90 strain, regarded as wild type, mating‐type switching (MTS) occurs every other cell division and requires HR to repair programmed double‐strand breaks (DSBs) at the mat1 locus. We show that the widely used heterothallic h −S strain is likewise dependent on HR for viability.
